title: Good quality, but not soft.
text: Good quality, but not soft.. These sheets are a good quality sheet.  They aren't like the thinner sheets out on the market these days.  They are only getting 3 stars because they are not soft at all. In fact, I consider them rough.  They aren't uncomfortable, but they are rough.  I don't recommend them if you are looking for soft sheets.
